criteria_assessment.cross_pillar_consistency: Approved only for the exact bounded documentary access-feasibility task in the current RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md, not for a physical realization or empirical response comparison. The reviewer independently read the final applied program, its native-feasibility-admission decision, the retained CT/JO, FO and CA boundaries, and all four current renewed prerequisite reviews. Their original prepared single-bridge scope, evidence anchors and primitive/derived assessments are unchanged. P1 supplies a complete conditional native causal law and distinguishes the additional CA access premises; P2 retains sufficient state, actual phase/capacity initialization, clock and partial-observation limits; P3 supplies prepared retention/recovery and transient response, not physical formation; P4 retains matched-law alternatives, nonuniqueness and discriminating negative or unavailable outcomes. Those foundations are jointly sufficient to ask whether independent access is documented, because the task does not assume an actuator, calibration or measurement bridge exists and does not compute or validate a physical response using one. This approval is restricted to the three frozen terrestrial families, at most one apparatus per family, six primary documents and six targeted search queries. The question is whether independently reported access warrants another review; no physical variable correspondence, fit, experiment, particle/field identity or application of the FO threshold to data is admitted. The CA selector/compensator remains an ideal mathematical port rather than a derived physical actuator. Zero net capacity transfer does not establish zero actuator cost or unchanged companion dynamics. FO 2^-166 is a sufficient native budget, not a necessary instrument resolution or proof of attainable precision; unit, gain and clock conversion are not supplied by this approval. The maximum positive outcome is a documented candidate warranting a separate bridge review, never an admitted realization or experimental validation. Missing documentation and failure of a particular case do not establish universal absence. Any follow-up that consumes a candidate-specific control, preparation, measurement map, reduction or physical prediction requires a new exact-task review covering its actual premises. The four foundational approvals are not silently expanded to autonomous hardware/control mechanisms. The reviewer previously provided schema/scope advice and reviewed the root-authored drafts, but did not author or edit the canonical decision, program or four pillar reviews. This final decision assesses their applied bytes and actual renewed associations; it is not an empirical attestation. No external search, scientific computation, simulation, test or producer replay was performed for this readiness review.
criteria_assessment.physical_mapping_scope: Readiness applies only to the frozen documentary question: whether independently published apparatus descriptions justify a candidate for a later realization/measurement-bridge review of the prepared one-bridge JO/FO consumer. It asks whether the needed access exists without presuming it. Review the three families in the program order: electronic oscillator networks, coupled mechanical resonators and electrochemical oscillator networks; at most one concrete apparatus per family, selected for documented access and ordinary terrestrial availability rather than waveform resemblance. The whole audit is capped at six primary documents and six targeted search queries. An article, separate supplement/methods document and repository acquisition documentation count separately; different views of one document count once. Selected unavailable items remain counted. Record identity, URL, family and selection reason before detailed assessment, then access date, available version/DOI/revision/commit and section/page support; unknown metadata remain unknown. Search results locate items and do not establish capabilities. At either limit stop new searches and selections; finish classification only from admitted material, without extra retrievals or queries. Close even if no candidate survives. Permitted evidence is primary papers, methods and authoritative acquisition descriptions of support/ports, complete published dynamics, preparation/reset, phase and capacity-related access, actual reference policy, filters/memory/environment, reactions/resources, simultaneous readout, gain/offset, elapsed clock and uncertainty. Separate source-backed facts from missing information and proposed interpretation. Do not infer native capacity from reported frequency, primitive phase from an extracted angle, or a complete law from an oscillator diagram. No physical correspondence is admitted, and the task excludes raw signal archive download, plot digitization, response extraction, model-output calculation, parameter fitting, simulation, controller installation, apparatus construction, experiments or scoring an empirical response. It excludes particles, fields, universal constants, formation claims and transfer of two-bridge acquisition/selection results. Existing source exposure is not reserved validation data. The ideal CA actuator and a programmed equation emulator cannot replace independent evidence for a candidate natural dynamics. FO 2^-166 remains sufficient rather than necessary and cannot be compared directly to instrument precision without a separately justified unit/gain/clock bridge. Classify cases only as documented incompatibility with a specified access condition; insufficient, inaccessible or not-yet-comparable evidence; or a documented candidate warranting a separate bridge review. The last is the maximum positive result and admits neither a realization nor a physical variable identification or experiment. Retain a source ledger and one result in the physical-assessment owner, with PROGRAM as the only queue, and recommend at most one later bridge review or concrete dependency. A new consumer, expanded budget, bridge derivation, fit, simulation or empirical evaluation requires its own substantive exact-task admission and applicable prospective F1-F4 declaration, final-source review, freeze and resource budget. Associate this receipt and the four current reviews in the registry, then run the unchanged strict prerequisite guard before the first external source inspection. Its generic physical mapping ready message authorizes only this frozen documentary scope. Changes to the program or a pillar review invalidate this binding; the completed audit does not authorize follow-up work implicitly.
